verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The captured run progressed from the title and hero-selection flow through the tutorial Continue action into the actual first dungeon tile map with the player character visible.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This is direct black-box game-entry evidence for the captured validation window only.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: A bounded horizontal swipe on the visible dungeon play surface was followed by a clearly different captured dungeon-board framing and player placement while the game remained active.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Only the directly captured input-to-visible-state transition is promoted; pathfinding, movement rules, hidden map logic and internal algorithms are not inferred.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The package remained alive and foreground after the exercised tutorial and dungeon inputs, with no captured FATAL EXCEPTION, SIGABRT, SIGSEGV or ANR marker in the validation log window.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves the captured validation window and does not claim indefinite long-run stability.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A mobile game can be running correctly while an Android immersive-mode overlay, title action, character selection or tutorial screen still blocks actual gameplay entry.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Preserve separate visual evidence for system overlay, title/onboarding, character selection, tutorial transition and actual gameplay entry before claiming a playable state.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: The first verified dungeon view immediately presents a concise touch interaction instruction while the playable board and character are already visible.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile onboarding, prefer contextual control guidance at the moment the relevant playable state is visible rather than front-loading a long instruction sequence.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A bounded touch or swipe becomes useful black-box evidence only when a corresponding visible gameplay-state transition is captured and the target process remains foreground and crash-free.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Bind mobile input evidence to before/after frames plus process, focus and crash checks; never infer success from input injection alone.

distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.lesson: Reaching hero selection or a tutorial descent screen is meaningful partial progress but is not equivalent to actual dungeon gameplay entry.
distilledPartialRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Keep onboarding milestones separate from the first verified playable-state milestone.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: A bounded input can miss a visible control even when the application is healthy; the resulting lack of transition is an automation-coordinate failure, not a game runtime failure.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: Use captured frames to correct the observed control coordinate and rerun the responsible input stage without lowering evidence gates.

allowed: runtime infrastructure and automation failure classification
portable mobile interaction lessons that may inform later Roblox-specific implementation and verification
stillForbidden: treating Android evidence as Roblox runtime evidence
hidden algorithm or pathfinding inference from the captured run
copying game artwork, UI trade dress, names or implementation details into a Roblox game
claims about long-run progression, balance or economy not measured by the captured validation window
